intro.text: An ancient book of parables written by King Nohadon, which deeply influenced Gavilar and Dalinar Kholin.

description.text: Nohadon wrote it after he had come to power, following one of the Desolations; it is meant as an allegory rather than a guide.
Unlike most writing of its era, preserved only in the unreadable Dawnchant, it was continually translated, largely thanks to the Vanrial, an order of artists preserving ancient texts and songs.
In Alethi glyphs its title is written with the symbols for "pathway" and "king".

items.text: After having it read to them many times, Gavilar and then Dalinar became more and more honourable, unlike most Alethi.
In a vision, Nohadon says he really made the journey behind the stories, though whether the individual parables are true is uncertain.
The ancient Knights Radiant were heavily influenced by the book; their Ideals may be based on it, and its first lines suggest the Bondsmiths' Third Ideal.
